bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 test -s /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs || exit 41
result="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs 2>&1)" || { echo "VIDEO_PIN_DRYRUN_FAILED"; exit 42; }
printf '%s' "$result" | grep -q '"mode":"DRY_RUN"' || exit 43
count="$(printf '%s' "$result" | grep -o '"pinState":"published"' | wc -l)"
test "$count" -eq 2 || { echo "TWO_PINS_NOT_PUBLISHED"; exit 44; }
echo "TWO_VIDEO_PIN_DB_AND_RIGHTS=PASS"
